vs_historical_cell3_dp006.mechanism_contrast: In the historical run, CoefDtMin=0.05 equaled CFL=0.05, which clamped the timestep 100% of the time to dtmin = coefdtmin * h / speedsound. This produced an effectively fixed-dt simulation. In genuine adaptive execution, CoefDtMin=0.005 decouples the minimum timestep by a factor of 10, allowing the CFL condition to dynamically govern the timestep.
vs_historical_cell3_dp006.reuse_prohibition: Historical fixed-step solver outputs must NOT be reused as adaptive reference evidence.

vs_coarse_diagnostic_dp015.role_distinction: DP 0.015m was authored in Root Followup 030 as an auxiliary coarse diagnostic forming a 6:4:3 integer ratio triad (0.015, 0.010, 0.0075) with bounded fast execution (<10 min on GPU). It provides early diagnostic signal but does NOT replace the historically registered reference ladder [0.010, 0.0075, 0.006] established in F3-CELL3-PROTOCOL.json. DP 0.006m remains the registered fine reference anchor of the campaign.

mass_conservation.discretization_notes: Because all dimensions are exact integer multiples of 0.006m, there is zero cell truncation or boundary clipping. Nominal discrete mass matches continuum mass exactly. No artificial mass rescaling or coordinate warping is introduced.

order_estimation_policy.constant_r_rejection: The spatial refinement ratios (4/3 and 5/4) are non-uniform. Any order-of-convergence evaluation must use generalized non-uniform order estimation or evaluate metric compliance directly against the frozen 5% spatial reference budget from f3_observation_v2.py. Constant-r logarithmic formulas are unphysical and rejected.
